checks.detail: Planck gives b=38, N=999, (1+b)/(N+1)=39/1000. ACT gives b=145, N=400, rank 146/401. The rounded MIO Pi report maps within its frozen tolerance to b=13, N=3000, rank 14/3001.

The Planck 95% whole-cluster percentile interval [0.026262626262626262, 0.05321285140562249] is expanded by the exact 1/1000 rank grid to [0.02526262626262626, 0.05421285140562249]. Its upper endpoint is not strictly below 0.05, so NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET is required. The strict rule also leaves a guard interval that merely touches a boundary unresolved.

The documented venv runner rebuilt and checked the Planck whole-noise-cluster bootstrap with seed 20260719 and 20000 draws, returning no output mismatches. An independent replay of the frozen three-cluster method fixture (seed 91, 512 draws) exactly reproduced mc_se=0.11792334566142526, median=0.3, and percentile interval [0.07692307692307693, 0.5714285714285714]. The implementation samples cluster indices and moves each selected cluster's complete binary row count and size together.

The 146/401 ACT conditional rank identity is retained, but both ACT targets correctly have null numerical-resolution status. The released scores share observation/simulation-derived crossfit mean fields, and the supplied aggregate/vector evidence does not contain a full delete-independent-unit crossfit recomputation or authenticated independent seed estimates; an iid rank or seed-SEM promotion would violate the frozen dependence contract.

The rank certificate uses probability for both estimand and boundary and applies only the dimensionless 1/(N+1) floor. The ACT scalar lane is explicitly kappa_band_power and contains no finite-resolution field. Scalar confidence logic compares same-unit interval endpoints to the same-unit boundary and never adds a rank floor.

Across seven registered targets, the independent recount is 0 resolved, 1 unresolved (Planck), 5 not certifiable (two ACT, MIO Pi, CF4 injection RMSE, CF4 fsigma8), and 1 not evaluated (partial-forbidden DESI). This exactly matches the frozen report summary, with all unavailable or uncertifiable certificate estimates, MC standard errors, and numerical statuses null.
